skill.name: copy-editing
skill.description: Reviews existing marketing and conversion copy through seven focused editing sweeps while preserving the original message and brand voice.
skill.summary: Improve marketing copy for clarity, credibility, specificity, tone, emotional impact, and conversion readiness.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns, and the source contains only editorial guidance in SKILL.md. Manual semantic review found no prompt injection, data-exfiltration intent, executable behavior, or business-logic abuse.

content.user_title: Improve Marketing Copy with Seven Focused Sweeps
content.value_statement: Marketing copy often loses clarity, consistency, credibility, or persuasive force during revision. This skill applies seven focused editing sweeps while preserving the original message and brand voice.
actual_capabilities: Reviews existing copy for clarity, ambiguous wording, jargon, and missing context.
Checks voice and tone consistency across sentences, paragraphs, and sections.
Connects product features to reader benefits and flags claims that lack supporting evidence.
Identifies vague language and recommends concrete wording, examples, numbers, or timeframes.
Evaluates emotional impact, objections, trust signals, and calls to action.
Presents specific edits with reasons and rechecks earlier sweeps after each revision.
limitations: Focuses on existing copy and does not replace full copywriting or page strategy.
Cannot verify statistics, testimonials, guarantees, or product claims without reliable source material.
Requires the audience, goal, desired action, and brand voice for a precise review.
Recommendations still require legal, compliance, accessibility, and subject-matter review when applicable.

use_cases.title: Refine Campaign Copy
use_cases.description: Improve email, advertisement, or landing-page copy while preserving the campaign message and established brand voice.

use_cases.title: Strengthen Product Messaging
use_cases.description: Turn feature-heavy product copy into clear, benefit-led language and identify claims that need evidence.

use_cases.title: Standardize Editorial Reviews
use_cases.description: Apply a repeatable seven-sweep process across team drafts and explain each recommended change.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Clarity Check
prompt_templates.prompt:
Review the copy below for clarity. Identify confusing sentences, jargon, ambiguous references, and missing context. Suggest focused edits that preserve the original meaning.

Copy: [paste copy]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a quick first review of a short draft.

prompt_templates.title: Align Voice and Tone
prompt_templates.prompt:
Edit this copy for a consistent [brand voice] tone. Mark unexpected shifts, explain each issue, and propose revisions without changing the core message.

Copy: [paste copy]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a draft sounds inconsistent across sections.

prompt_templates.title: Complete Seven Sweeps
prompt_templates.prompt:
Apply all seven copy-editing sweeps to this [content type] for [audience]. The goal is [goal], and the desired action is [action]. Present findings by sweep, then provide revised copy.

Copy: [paste copy]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a complete conversion-copy review.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Claims and Conversion Barriers
prompt_templates.prompt:
Audit this copy for unsupported claims, vague benefits, weak proof, emotional relevance, objections, trust signals, and call-to-action friction. Separate verified facts from recommendations. Do not invent evidence. Recheck clarity and voice after revising.

Copy: [paste copy]
Available evidence: [list sources]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced review before publication or testing.

output_examples.input: Our innovative platform leverages AI to optimize your workflow and save you time.
output_examples.output: Issue: The sentence relies on vague terms. Revision: Our AI platform helps your team complete routine work faster.

output_examples.input: Trusted by thousands of companies to deliver industry-leading results.
output_examples.output: The claim needs proof. Add a verified customer count, named testimonial, or sourced result. Otherwise, soften the statement.

output_examples.input: Contact us to learn more about our free consultation.
output_examples.output: Book your free consultation. Share your goals, then receive clear recommendations and next steps.

best_practices: Provide the copy goal, target audience, desired action, brand voice, and available evidence.
Review one sweep at a time and explain why each proposed edit improves the copy.
Confirm that later edits preserve clarity, voice, factual accuracy, and the original message.
anti_patterns: Do not request a full rewrite when the original message or voice must remain intact.
Do not add numbers, testimonials, guarantees, or outcomes that the provided evidence does not support.
Do not optimize emotion or urgency in ways that hide costs, risks, conditions, or material facts.

faq.question: Does this skill write new copy from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It improves existing copy. Use a copywriting workflow to create the first draft, then apply this skill.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the draft, audience, goal, desired action, brand voice, known concerns, and evidence for important claims.

faq.question: Will it preserve my brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes, when you describe the intended voice or provide representative examples. Review final wording for brand-specific requirements.

faq.question: Can it verify marketing claims?
faq.answer: It can flag claims that need support. It cannot verify statistics, testimonials, or product results without reliable source material.

faq.question: Must every review use all seven sweeps?
faq.answer: No. Use quick checks for narrow issues and the full framework for complete conversion-copy reviews.

faq.question: What does the final review include?
faq.answer: It can include findings by sweep, reasons for changes, specific recommendations, and revised copy that preserves the core message.
